name: Presentr Analyze
tagline: Translate and re-time subtitles, read text aloud and dub media
description: Presentr Analyze turns media and documents into deliverables: transcripts and captions, subtitles re-timed against the audio or translated into other languages, text read aloud as audio, dubbed video, and text pulled out of scanned PDFs and photos.
